stories.title: Krakow shooting suspect dies in hospital after six killed
stories.summary: The suspect in a shooting in Krakow has died of his injuries, Polish police said, after six people were killed and the bodies of three of his family members were found at their home. The attack was one of Poland's deadliest in years and prompted a broad manhunt.

stories.title: Steel plant blast in western Turkey kills 3, 10 missing
stories.summary: An explosion at a steel plant in western Turkey killed at least three workers and left 10 missing, with emergency crews searching the site. Authorities are investigating the cause of the blast.

stories.title: Trump to meet Qatar's emir as Iran war endgame stalls
stories.summary: President Trump is set to meet Qatar's leader, a key mediator in the Iran war, but officials see no imminent deal to end the conflict more than eight months after it began. Trump has played down the prospect of major fighting resuming while rejecting Iran's existing truce plan.

stories.title: At least 34 dead after migrant boat sinks off Senegal
stories.summary: A boat carrying migrants toward Spain's Canary Islands sank off Senegal, killing at least 34 people. The Atlantic route remains one of the world's deadliest for people seeking to reach Europe.

stories.title: Instagram expands AI age detection worldwide
stories.summary: Meta is rolling out AI-powered age detection for Instagram globally, automatically placing millions more teens into Teen Account protections with stricter messaging and privacy defaults. The tool had previously been limited to the US, EU and Brazil.

stories.title: China denies involvement in alleged Nvidia spy plot
stories.summary: China's government rejected claims that it sent a spy to gather information on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, calling the allegations groundless. The denial follows reports that a Megaspeed executive was recruited to get close to Huang.

stories.title: Tesla expands robotaxi service to San Antonio
stories.summary: Tesla began offering robotaxi rides in San Antonio on Monday, its latest Texas market as it tries to scale driverless service against Waymo. The company gave few details on fleet size, hours or whether human safety monitors will be on board.

stories.title: Yale's Sonnenfeld puts Huang's job odds at 'about 50-50'
stories.summary: Yale management professor Jeffrey Sonnenfeld estimated the odds Jensen Huang loses the Nvidia CEO role at roughly even, as the board investigates his relationship with a Megaspeed executive U.S. officials suspect of spying for China. Nvidia says it has seen no sign that company secrets or national security were compromised.

stories.title: Browns face QB decision after Sanders' overtime loss
stories.summary: Shedeur Sanders' 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints has forced Cleveland's front office to weigh his long-term upside against Deshaun Watson's five fourth-quarter comeback wins this season. Coach Todd Monken declined to name a starter for Week 10.

stories.title: Browns have nothing brewing before Tuesday's trade deadline
stories.summary: Cleveland has no imminent moves ahead of Tuesday's NFL trade deadline, with Maliek Collins having sat out the Saints game because of illness. The 5-4 Browns now return home after playing six of their first nine on the road.

stories.title: Penalties sink Browns again in overtime loss to Saints
stories.summary: Cleveland, the NFL's most-penalized team, drew 10 flags against New Orleans, including a holding call on the final play of overtime that sealed the 23-22 defeat. It was the Browns' second straight loss.

stories.title: Browns rookies give offense a bright spot in defeat
stories.summary: Rookies Denzel Boston, KC Concepcion and tight end Harold Fannin Jr. produced standout performances in the 23-22 overtime loss, giving Cleveland a promising young core on offense despite the result.

stories.title: Ex-Buckeye Arvell Reese becomes youngest with 3-sack NFL game
stories.summary: Former Ohio State and Glenville star Arvell Reese recorded 12 tackles, three sacks and a forced fumble in the Giants' 19-11 win over the Eagles, becoming the youngest player in NFL history with a three-sack game.

stories.title: Skull Session: the missed chances that define Ohio State's season
stories.summary: Eleven Warriors traces Ohio State's 41-28 loss to Oregon to a dropped interception and a fake punt that let the Ducks score 21 unanswered points in the middle eight. It is the latest in a season defined by squandered opportunities for the 6-3 Buckeyes.

stories.title: Mekies: Verstappen outperformed Red Bull's simulations in Brazil
stories.summary: Red Bull's Laurent Mekies praised Max Verstappen's wet-weather feel after the driver charged from 21st on the grid to second at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix. Mekies said Verstappen found grip the team's simulations had not predicted.

stories.title: Stella explains the calls behind Norris' Interlagos win
stories.summary: McLaren principal Andrea Stella detailed how the team made the right strategy calls in mixed conditions to put Lando Norris in position to win the Sao Paulo Grand Prix. The victory came as Mercedes clinched the constructors' title.

stories.title: Piastri and Webber terminate management agreement
stories.summary: Oscar Piastri and Mark and Ann Webber have mutually ended their management agreement, the pair announced. The Webbers had managed Piastri since 2019, through his rise from Formula Renault to McLaren and multiple F1 wins.

stories.title: Vasseur explains Ferrari's tyre struggles in Brazil
stories.summary: Ferrari principal Fred Vasseur said the team could not get its tyres into the right operating window during the Sao Paulo Grand Prix. Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton both called the race a disaster for the team.

stories.title: Land-Grant acquires Nocterra, will reopen Powell taproom
stories.summary: Columbus-based Land-Grant Brewing has acquired Nocterra Brewing and plans to reopen its Powell taproom in late November as a holiday pop-up. Land-Grant will then close the space in January for an extensive renovation; it did not acquire Nocterra's Scioto Audubon location.

stories.title: Ohio begins transition to Acton-led state government
stories.summary: Gov.-elect Amy Acton has started the transition to become Ohio's 71st governor, the first Democrat to hold the office since 2011. She has launched a website asking residents to get involved in her incoming administration.

stories.title: Ohio State fraternity suspended after video shows people on fire
stories.summary: Ohio State placed Sigma Alpha Epsilon on interim suspension while it investigates a viral video that appears to show two people set on fire. A university spokesperson said the review began late Sunday after officials saw the footage.

stories.title: Trial opens for Pammy Maye in death of 5-year-old Darnell Taylor
stories.summary: Jury selection and opening arguments begin Monday in the trial of Pammy Maye, 51, charged with aggravated murder, tampering with evidence and abuse of a corpse in the death of 5-year-old Darnell Taylor. The case drew national attention after an AMBER Alert in 2024.
